scripts.update: prisma migrate dev && npm run generate
scripts.update:force: prisma migrate dev && npm run generate
scripts.dev: npm run dev:up && concurrently "npm run dev:server" "npm run worker:dev"
scripts.dev:only-server: npm run dev:up && npm run dev:server
scripts.db:reset: node confirm.js "Este comando aplicará las migraciones existentes desde cero. Se borrarán los datos pero NO el historial de migraciones. ¿Continuar?" && npm run generate && prisma migrate reset
scripts.setup:queues: tsx -e "import { pgmq } from './src/utils/pgmq'; const setup = async () => { const queues = ['email_notifications', 'pipeline_jobs', 'background_tasks', 'file_deletions']; for (const q of queues) { try { await pgmq.createQueue(q); console.log('✅ Queue created:', q); } catch (e) { console.log('⚠️ Queue exists:', q); } } process.exit(0); }; setup();"
scripts.generate: npm run generate:prisma && npm run generate:graphql
scripts.pretest: npm run test:db:clean && npm run test:db:generate && npm run test:db:push
scripts.dev:reset: docker compose --env-file docker/dev/.env -f docker-compose.dev.yml down -v && npm run dev:setup
scripts.dev:wait:pg: until docker compose --env-file docker/dev/.env -f docker-compose.dev.yml exec -T postgres pg_isready -U postgres > /dev/null 2>&1; do echo 'Waiting for PostgreSQL...'; sleep 2; done && echo 'PostgreSQL is ready!'
scripts.copy:assets: npm run copy:graphql && npm run copy:prisma-client && npm run copy:paljs-dmmf && npm run copy:frontend && npm run copy:api-docs && npm run copy:src-assets
scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run generate && tsc && npm run copy:assets
scripts.build:docker: npm run clean && npm run build:fast
scripts.build:fast:safe: npm run typecheck && npm run build:fast
scripts.docker:clean:agilbank: echo '🧹 Limpiando recursos Docker de Agilbank...' && docker images | grep agilbank | awk '{print $3}' | xargs -r docker rmi -f 2>/dev/null; docker ps -a | grep agilbank | awk '{print $1}' | xargs -r docker rm -f 2>/dev/null; docker builder prune -f
scripts.docker:clean:agilbank:safe: echo '🔍 Analizando recursos Docker de Agilbank...' && docker images | grep agilbank | wc -l | xargs -I {} echo '📦 {} imágenes de agilbank encontradas' && docker ps -a | grep agilbank | wc -l | xargs -I {} echo '📦 {} contenedores de agilbank encontrados' && echo '💡 Ejecuta npm run docker:clean:agilbank para limpiarlos'
scripts.docker:prune: echo '⚠️  WARNING: This will delete Docker resources older than 24h from ALL projects!' && echo '   This affects your entire Docker installation, not just Agilbank.' && echo '' && echo -n 'Type yes to confirm: ' && read confirm && [ $confirm = yes ] && docker system prune -af --filter 'until=24h' || echo 'Cancelled.'
scripts.docker:prune:all: echo '⚠️  WARNING: This will delete ALL unused Docker resources from ALL projects!' && echo '   This affects your entire Docker installation, not just Agilbank.' && echo '' && echo -n 'Type yes to confirm: ' && read confirm && [ $confirm = yes ] && docker system prune -af || echo 'Cancelled.'
scripts.docker:prune:volumes: echo '⚠️  WARNING: This will delete ALL Docker resources (images, containers, volumes) from ALL projects!' && echo '   This affects your entire Docker installation, not just Agilbank.' && echo '' && echo -n 'Type yes to confirm: ' && read confirm && [ $confirm = yes ] && docker system prune -af --volumes || echo 'Cancelled.'
scripts.db:migrate:gis: prisma migrate dev --create-only && ts-node ./gis/postGisMigrations.ts && npm run update
scripts.db:fresh: node confirm.js "Este comando creará una base de datos nueva con migración inicial. Se borrarán TODOS los datos y el historial de migraciones. ¿Continuar?" && npm run generate && rimraf prisma/migrations && prisma migrate reset --force && prisma migrate dev --name initial_migration && prisma db seed
scripts.db:fresh:force: npm run generate && rimraf prisma/migrations && prisma migrate reset --force && prisma migrate dev --name initial_migration && prisma db seed
scripts.db:init: npm run dev:up && npm run dev:wait:pg && npm run db:init:schema
scripts.db:init:schema: rimraf prisma/migrations && mkdir -p prisma/migrations/20010101000000_initial && npx prisma db push && npx prisma migrate diff --from-empty --to-schema prisma/schema.prisma --script > prisma/migrations/20010101000000_initial/migration.sql && npm run db:init:rebase && npx prisma migrate resolve --applied 20010101000000_initial && npm run dev:seed
scripts.//db:init:rebase: Limpia el historial ANTES de re-registrar la base. Sin esto el script no es idempotente: reescribe migration.sql pero el checksum de la corrida anterior queda registrado, y despues prisma migrate dev corta con 'the migration was modified after it was applied' y pide un reset que borra los datos.
scripts.db:init:rebase: echo 'DELETE FROM _prisma_migrations;' | npx prisma db execute --stdin
scripts.db:reset:force: npm run generate && prisma migrate reset --force
